description: Change of use of the front section of the existing mini cab office to retail.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (A.01; A.02; A.03  Received:  19 August 2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - Before the shop use hereby approved commences, the internal waste and recyclable materials store detailed in drawing A.01 submitted on 19 August 2020 shall have been installed.  Bagged waste and recyclable materials shall only be placed on the public footway for collection no more than two hours before the planned collection time.  No unbagged waste shall be placed on the public footway under any circumstances and any bagged waste or bins remaining following a collection shall be immediately removed by the retail unit's occupier.

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the terms of The Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) (Amendment) (England) Regulations 2020, The Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 and any successor legislation, the premise shall be used as a retail shop and/or mini-cab office and for no other purpose including any use within Use Class E of the 1987 Order (as amended).
